title: Baagi ba Ditora
intro: Mo nakong e e fetileng bogologolo, go ne ga tsoga tlhabologo e e nonofileng, e e neng e farologanngwa ka ditiro tsa yone tse di kgatlhang tsa go aga le maatla a yone a a boitshegang. Setlhopha seno se se kopaneng se ne sa newa ditsompelo tse dintsi le bokgoni jwa mmele, le fa go ntse jalo ba ne ba tlhopha tsela ya go gana molaetsa wa bomodimo o o neng o rometswe go ba kaela. Kgang ya bone e dira jaaka thuto e e tseneletseng mo dibukeng tsa hisitori, e le bosupi jwa ditlamorago tsa go gana boammaaruri.
clues: Re ne ra newa maatla a a seng kana ka sepe a mmele le bogolo, re sa tshwane le batho bape ba bangwe ba motlha wa rona.
Re ne re itsege ka go aga dikago tse dikgolo le dipilara tse di kwa godimo mo lefelong lengwe le lengwe le le kwa godimo, re akanya gore re tla tshelela ruri.
Go ne ga romelwa morongwa go tswa mo gare ga rona go tla go re tlhagisa, a re bitsa gore re obamele Allah fela le go tlogela medingwana ya rona.

Re ne ra botsa morongwa wa rona dipotso ka boikgogomoso, re botsa gore a ba ne ba tla kwa go rona fela go tla go dira gore re obamele Allah le go tlogela se bagologolwane ba rona ba neng ba se obamela.
Lefatshe la rona le ne le segofaditswe ka ditshingwana, metswedi le masimo a a nonneng, mme re ne re re katlego ya rona e bakilwe ke maatla a rona, e seng Mmopi wa rona.
Ka ntlha ya go sa dumele ga rona le go sotlwa ga rona ka metlha, kgabagare re ne ra nyelediwa ke phefo e e tshosang, e e galefileng e e neng ya thunya malatsi le masigo a le mantsi.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
